start_cue.en: Hold the weights up, then lower them slowly.
start_cue.hi: Weight upar pakdo, phir dheere neeche lao.

good.en: Good. The bench is at a low incline.
good.hi: Badhiya. Bench thoda sa tilted hai.

almost.en: Set the bench a little higher.

fix.en: Set the bench to one notch up from flat.
fix.hi: Bench ko flat se ek notch upar set karo.

good.en: Good. You went down low enough.

above.en: Go lower. Take the dumbbells down to your chest.
above.hi: Neeche jao. Dumbbell chest tak lao.

below.en: That is very deep. Stop when your upper arm is level.
below.hi: Yeh bahut neeche chala gaya. Upper arm level aate hi ruko.

fix.en: Lower until your upper arms are level with your torso.
fix.hi: Neeche tab tak jao jab tak upper arm shareer ke level na aaye.

good.en: Good. Your arms went fully straight.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapke haath poore seedhe hue.

almost.en: Push a little higher. Make your arms straight.
almost.hi: Thoda aur upar dhakelo. Haath seedhe karo.

fix.en: Push all the way up. Make your arms fully straight.
fix.hi: Poora upar dhakelo. Haath poore seedhe karo.

good.en: Good. Your hands are right above your elbows.
good.hi: Badhiya. Haath kohni ke seedha upar hain.

almost.en: Keep your wrists over your elbows.
almost.hi: Haath kohni ke seedha upar rakho.

fix.en: Your hands drift. Keep wrists stacked over elbows.
fix.hi: Haath hat rahe hain. Kohni ke seedha upar rakho.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds going down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.

below.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weights. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Keep a steady 2 seconds down.
above.hi: Bahut dheere hai. Neeche aane mein 2 second rakho.

fix.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weights. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: One arm is a little behind. Move them together.
almost.hi: Ek haath thoda peeche hai. Dono saath chalao.

fix.en: One arm is much lower. Move both arms together.
fix.hi: Ek haath bahut neeche hai. Dono haath saath chalao.
